notes: Recorded 31 thesis-based master's programmes (28 M.Sc. entries, Master of Science in Petroleum Engineering which the page labels "B.Sc.", and 2 "M.T" entries: Master in Geology, Master in Geophysics) and 19 Ph.D. programmes: the full thesis-based and Ph.D. lists on the official programmes page. The bulletin page lists 51 graduate programmes and agrees with these names; it also adds no thesis MS or PhD entry that is missing here.

The first pass listed 25 of the master's entries; this pass adds Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Physics, Systems and Control Engineering (Thesis option), Master in Geology and Master in Geophysics.

Not recorded: about 50 project-based (cohort) and executive master's programmes marked "MX" on the programmes page (for example MBA, Executive MBA, MS in Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science and Analytics, Engineering Management, Quantum Computing and others). The scholarship page speaks only of full-time MS and PhD students and of all PhD programmes; it does not say whether project-based programmes carry the scholarship, and the admission page gives them separate rules.
The programmes page counts 28 M.Sc., 2 M.T and 19 Ph.D. entries in this thesis-based set; the introduction on that page cites 17 thesis-based master's programmes, which does not match its own list.
The direct-entry PhD (B.S. holders, five years, scholarship for the first four) is a route into the PhD programmes above, not a separate major.
not_stated: Which master's programmes carry a scholarship (the page says only "full-time MS" students admitted with scholarship)
